messages:
Elena P: Quick sync — proposing a concise SI co-sell intake + handoff routing so leads from marketplace/hw partners don't fall into a black hole. Short bullets below, want sharp yes/no so we can update intake sheet and gen-messaging.
AJ: high level sounds good. what's the SLA for a claim/response?
Elena P: thinking 48h to acknowledge + 5 business days to accept/decline. if no response accept->auto-assign to regional SD/AE.
Tom W: can we codify mapping keys? region/partner/lead_source/claim_tier?
Elena P: yes — proposal: region, partner, lead_source, ownership_policy, claim_window_hours, escalation_owner. simple CSV snippet: 
```
partner,region,lead_source,ownership_policy,claim_window_hours,escalation_owner
SkyBridge,NA,marketplace,si_first_claim_wins,48,aj@redwood
AtlasHW,EMEA,hw-reseller,partner_priority_then_sd,72,tom@redwood
```
Rachel L: add contact_point (POC email) and deal_stage to help prioritization. also suggest a tag `si_partner_claimed:true` for reporting.
Sahil R: we should include a minimum MQL score threshold to auto-route to SI queue (score >= 60). otherwise it stays in product-led pipeline. also need an ops dashboard to show "unclaimed leads >48h" for weekly sweeps.
Elena P: +1 to score threshold. default: score >=60 OR ARR >= 50k -> route to SI intake. otherwise route to PL.
AJ: for cases where both SI and field claim, what's tie-breaker?
Tom W: propose tie-break order: 1) partner contractual priority, 2) partner_first_claim_ts, 3) regional AE override (requires manual note).
Rachel L: we should avoid manual disputes. recommend a short adjudication flow: if tie -> auto-notify "co-sell-escalation" channel with minimal metadata (lead id, accounts, claimers) and SLA 24h.
partner-ops-bot: Inventory sheet updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partnerships/si-intake (doc id 893) — webhook confirmation :white_check_mark:
Elena P: thanks bot. Next steps: Tom update intake CSV/schema by EOD, AJ to confirm escalation owner list, Rachel draft partner-facing claim instructions + email template, Sahil add dashboard tickets to revops backlog. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if they can take these?
AJ: :thumbsup: I'll confirm owners.
Tom W: :thumbsup: I'll push schema and sample ETL to the sheet.
Rachel L: :thumbsup: will draft messaging and share in #partnerships for review.
Sahil R: :thumbsup: creating dashboard ticket (RVOPS-118) and tagging revops.
Elena P: awesome — I'll update the intake form to include partner_priority, poc_email, mql_score, deal_stage, and claim_ts. Will also add the adjudication webhook to the confluence doc. Ping here when complete and we'll close the loop. :rocket:
Tom W: ETA for schema/ETL: 4pm PT.
AJ: ETA for escalation owners: EOD tomorrow.
Rachel L: messaging draft by tomorrow noon.
Sahil R: dashboard ticket created, linking the dataset in the confluence doc now.
Elena P: perfect. thanks all — keeping this thread as canonical for the intake change.
